name: ShoppingCart
description: Mortar shopping cart: bag lines with image, options, price, stock, a quantity select and a remove button labelled with the product name; focus moves to the next line after a removal. Shows an empty state when there are no items.

props.items: CartItem[] ({ id: string; name: string; href: string; price: string; quantity: number; image: { src: string; alt: string }; meta?: string; stock?: string })
props.label: string
props.headingLevel: 1 | 2 | 3 | 4 | 5 | 6 (default 3; each line's product name and the empty state's title)
props.empty: { title: string; description?: string; action?: ReactNode } (default "Your bag is empty")

contract.usage: Import { ShoppingCart } from @tony-ui/mortar. Compose with the public typed props.
contract.avoid: Do not copy implementations, override central colours or grant component approval.
contract.accessibility: Verify accessible names, keyboard interaction, visible focus, responsive layout and supported states.
